description: Make all page layouts (Dashboard, Documents, Employees, Fraud, Meetings, Security, Workspace) responsive for mobile with proper grid stacking and horizontal scroll for tables
steps: 1. Update Dashboard page (src/app/page.tsx): Welcome banner padding should be p-4 on mobile, sm:p-6, lg:p-8 on larger. Quick action buttons flex-wrap. Telemetry cards grid: grid-cols-1 on mobile, sm:grid-cols-3 on desktop (already present). Main content grid: grid-cols-1 on mobile, lg:grid-cols-3 on desktop (already present). Action items list should stack on mobile. Task cards should have adequate touch targets

2. Update Documents page (src/app/documents/page.tsx): Header section padding p-4 sm:p-6. Filter row should stack on mobile: flex-col on mobile, sm:flex-row. Vault selector and classification filter should be full-width on mobile. Document cards in grid: grid-cols-1 on mobile, sm:grid-cols-2, lg:grid-cols-3. Compare mode document selectors should stack on mobile. Comparison result table should have horizontal scroll wrapper on mobile: overflow-x-auto with min-w-full table

3. Update Employees page (src/app/employees/page.tsx): Header buttons should stack or wrap on mobile. Search bar full-width on mobile. Department filter should stack below search on mobile. Employee cards grid: grid-cols-1 on mobile, sm:grid-cols-2, lg:grid-cols-3. Team cards similar responsive grid

4. Update Fraud page (src/app/fraud/page.tsx): Header actions should wrap on mobile. Summary cards grid: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4. Filter row should stack on mobile. Transactions table must have horizontal scroll on mobile: wrap table in div with overflow-x-auto, ensure table has min-w-[800px] or similar to trigger scroll. Investigation panel on mobile should be full-width modal instead of side panel

5. Update Meetings page (src/app/meetings/page.tsx): Similar patterns to other pages: header padding adjusts, filter/action row stacks, meeting cards grid responsive (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2), meeting detail view with MoM content should stack sections on mobile. Attendees list, action items, and other tabular data should be in scrollable containers on mobile

6. Update Security page (src/app/security/page.tsx): Passkey cards, biometric enrollment, and security settings should stack on mobile. Forms should be full-width with adequate spacing. Security log table needs horizontal scroll on mobile

7. Update Workspace page (src/app/workspace/page.tsx): AI chat interface should be full-width on mobile. Tool cards should stack (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3). Any split-panel layouts should collapse to single column on mobile

8. Add global utility classes to globals.css if not present: .overflow-x-auto for horizontal scrolling, .custom-scrollbar styles for thin mobile-friendly scrollbars, .touch-target utility (min-h-11 min-w-11 or 44px equivalent)
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard page displays correctly at 375px width: cards stack vertically, buttons are tappable
Documents page at 375px: filters stack, document grid is single column, comparison table scrolls horizontally
Employees page at 375px: search and filters stack, employee cards single column
Fraud page at 375px: summary cards stack, transactions table scrolls horizontally
Meetings page at 375px: meeting cards stack, MoM content is readable without horizontal overflow
Security page at 375px: forms and settings stack appropriately
Workspace page at 375px: chat interface is full-width and usable
No page has unwanted horizontal scroll on mobile except for intentional table scroll containers
verification: Run 'npm run build' to verify no build errors
Test each page route at 375px width in browser DevTools mobile emulation
Test at 768px (tablet) and 1024px (desktop) to ensure responsive breakpoints work
Verify tables on Fraud and Documents pages scroll horizontally on mobile
Verify all grids collapse to single column on mobile and expand on larger screens
Check that no text or content is cut off or requires horizontal scroll (except tables)
